ui.agent.description.d4da2b3b5746: Read Xprite's open documents, active document, content revisions, layers, zero-based frames, selection, palette and editing limits. Read before editing; document pixels remain in this browser.
ui.agent.description.f4563689a4a7: Render a document frame or region as an sRGB PNG data URL, independent of viewport zoom. frameIndex is zero-based and defaults to the active frame; rect defaults to the whole sprite.
ui.agent.description.469ebad48705: Read a region of working-space RGBA bytes and the current selection mask in row-major order. Omit layerId for the visible composite. Missing cel pixels are transparent. frameIndex defaults to the active frame. Maximum 65536 pixels per read.
ui.agent.description.a0ff07b1362c: Create and open a new RGBA sprite. Existing documents remain open. Background defaults to transparent. Maximum 2048 pixels per side.
ui.agent.description.ca2fe9531549: Apply 1–128 operations atomically as one undo step to an RGBA document. All coordinates are sprite pixels, all frame indices zero-based. Explicit colors replace RGBA, including transparency; current selection clips painting. Locked, hidden, reference and non-image layers cannot be painted. Linked cels remain linked. moveLayer uses the editor's move-to-target order. addFrame inserts after afterFrameIndex and defaults to duplicating it. Existing active layer/frame and brush settings are preserved. A revision conflict or pending user edit rejects the batch; read context again.
ui.agent.description.2be3030883c2: Undo the latest history entry in the specified document, including user entries. Requires the current content revision and no pending edit. Returns whether history changed.
ui.agent.description.efc64da2ef1d: Redo the next history entry in the specified document. Requires the current content revision and no pending edit. Returns whether history changed.
ui.agent.description.26258849b1c8: Return PNG (one frame) or Aseprite (complete project) as base64 file bytes. Does not download, open a file picker, mark saved or upload. Requires no pending edit. PNG defaults to the active frame.
